title: Middle of a LinkedList [TortoiseHare Method]
stepTitle: Learn LinkedList [Single LL, Double LL, Medium, Hard Problems]
category: Learn LinkedList [Single LL, Double LL, Medium, Hard Problems]
problemStatement: Find the middle node of a singly linked list in one pass (second middle if even).
intuition: A pointer moving twice as fast reaches the end exactly when the slow pointer reaches the middle. No length computation, no second pass.

approaches.title: Brute: count then walk again
Optimal: tortoise and hare
approaches.idea: Advance slow by one and fast by two.
approaches.dryRun:
1->2->3->4->5
slow 1,2,3 while fast 1,3,5 -> fast.next is None -> middle is 3
approaches.whyWorks: fast travels exactly twice the distance of slow, so slow lands at n//2.

edgeCases: Even length — which middle is expected?
commonMistakes: Checking only `fast` and dereferencing fast.next.next on None
Returning the first middle when the second is required
patternRecognition: Slow/fast pointers: middle, cycle detection, k-th from the end, palindrome check
followUps: Split the list into two halves
interviewInsight: The `while fast and fast.next` guard is the single most common crash in linked-list interviews.
